name: Rogue
equipment: (a) a shortbow and quiver of 20 arrows or (b) a shortsword
(a) a burglar's pack, (b) dungeoneer's pack, or (c) an explorer's pack
Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.desc: Once per turn: finesse or ranged weapon, with advantage or an ally next to the target

1.name: Expertise
1.desc: Double proficiency for two skills (or one plus thieves' tools); two more at 6th.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.desc: Once per turn, extra damage (see table) on a finesse or ranged hit with advantage, or when an active ally is next to the target and you lack disadvantage.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.desc: Secret jargon hidden in ordinary speech (four times slower) and signs marking danger, loot or safe houses.

2.name: Cunning Action
2.desc: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.desc: Reaction: halve the damage of a hit from an attacker you can see.

6.name: Expertise
6.desc: Double proficiency for two skills (or one plus thieves' tools); two more at 6th.

7.name: Evasion
7.desc: DEX saves for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure.

11.name: Reliable Talent
11.desc: On checks with your proficiency, a d20 of 9 or less counts as 10.

14.name: Blindsense
14.desc: If you can hear, you know where hidden or invisible creatures within 10 ft are.

18.name: Elusive
18.desc: Attacks against you never have advantage unless you are incapacitated.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.desc: Turn a miss into a hit or a failed check into a natural 20; once per short rest.

3.name: Spellcasting
3.desc: Third caster from the wizard list, INT: Mage Hand plus two cantrips (one more at 10th); spells known mostly enchantment or illusion, any school at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th.

3.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
3.desc: Invisible Mage Hand that can plant or lift items from others' containers and use thieves' tools at range (Sleight of Hand vs Perception); control it with Cunning Action.

9.name: Magical Ambush
9.desc: Hidden when casting on a creature: it has disadvantage on saves against that spell this turn.

13.name: Versatile Trickster
13.desc: Bonus action: advantage this turn against a creature within 5 ft of your Mage Hand.

17.name: Spell Thief
17.desc: Reaction to a spell targeting you: caster saves against your DC or the spell fails on you and you know it for 8 h (it can't cast it); once per long rest.

actions.name: Death Strike
actions.desc: Hit on a surprised creature: CON save DC {dc:DEX} or the damage is doubled

3.name: Assassinate
3.desc: Advantage against creatures that haven't acted yet; hits on surprised creatures are crits.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise
9.desc: 7 days and 25 gp build a false identity others believe unless given clear reason not to.

13.name: Impostor
13.desc: After 3 h studying someone, mimic their speech, writing and behavior; advantage on Deception if suspected.

17.name: Death Strike
17.desc: Hitting a surprised creature: CON save (8 + DEX + prof) or double damage.

toggles.name: Assassinate
toggles.desc: On while the target is surprised: every hit is a critical; advantage on creatures that have not acted yet

3.name: Ear for Deceit
3.desc: Insight to detect lies: a d20 of 7 or less counts as 8.

3.name: Eye for Detail
3.desc: Bonus action Perception to spot hidden things or Investigation for clues.

3.name: Insightful Fighting
3.desc: Bonus action Insight vs Deception: Sneak Attack the target without advantage for 1 min (not with disadvantage).

9.name: Steady Eye
9.desc: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move at most half speed this turn.

13.name: Unerring Eye
13.desc: Action: sense illusions, shapechangers and deceptive magic within 30 ft, without details (WIS mod/long rest).

17.name: Eye for Weakness
17.desc: +3d6 Sneak Attack against a target of Insightful Fighting.

3.name: Master of Intrigue
3.desc: Disguise kit, forgery kit, a gaming set, two languages; copy an accent after 1 min of listening.

3.name: Master of Tactics
3.desc: Help as a bonus action; helping an ally attack works on targets within 30 ft that see or hear you.

9.name: Insightful Manipulator
9.desc: After 1 min observing, learn whether a creature is equal, superior or inferior to you in two of INT, WIS, CHA or class levels.

13.name: Misdirection
13.desc: Reaction: an attack on you is redirected to the adjacent creature giving you cover.

17.name: Soul of Deceit
17.desc: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it (Deception to fake them) and truth-detecting magic reads you as truthful.

3.name: Whispers of the Dead
3.desc: After each rest gain one skill or tool proficiency, kept until you swap it.

3.name: Wails from the Grave
3.desc: After Sneak Attack, a second creature within 30 ft of the target takes half your Sneak Attack dice as necrotic (prof bonus/long rest).

9.name: Tokens of the Departed
9.desc: Reaction when a creature dies within 30 ft: gain a soul trinket (max prof bonus). Carrying one: advantage on death and CON saves; destroy one for a free Wails or to ask its spirit a question.

13.name: Ghost Walk
13.desc: Bonus action spectral form for 10 min: 10 ft fly and hover, attacks against you at disadvantage, pass through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside); once per long rest or a soul trinket.

17.name: Death's Friend
17.desc: Wails from the Grave hits both creatures; a long rest gives a soul trinket if you have none.

3.name: Skirmisher
3.desc: Reaction: move half speed without opportunity attacks when an enemy ends its turn next to you.

3.name: Survivalist
3.desc: Proficiency and expertise in Nature and Survival.

9.name: Superior Mobility
9.desc: +10 ft walking, climbing and swimming speed.

13.name: Ambush Master
13.desc: Advantage on initiative; the first creature you hit in round one is attacked with advantage by everyone until your next turn.

17.name: Sudden Strike
17.desc: Bonus action attack after the Attack action, able to Sneak Attack a different target.

3.name: Psionic Power
3.desc: Psionic dice (2 x prof bonus, d6 to d12 by level, long rest, bonus action regains one per short rest): add one to a failed proficient check (spent only on success), or telepathy with up to prof bonus creatures for hours equal to a roll.

3.name: Psychic Blades
3.desc: With the Attack action, a finesse thrown (60 ft) psychic blade, 1d6 + mod; bonus action second blade 1d4.

9.name: Soul Blades
9.desc: Add a Psionic die to a missed blade attack (spent on a hit), or bonus action to throw a blade and teleport 10 x the roll in feet.

13.name: Psychic Veil
13.desc: Action: invisible for 1 h, ending when you deal damage or force a save; once per long rest or a Psionic die.

17.name: Rend Mind
17.desc: Sneak Attack with a Psychic Blade: WIS save (8 + prof + DEX) or stunned 1 min, save each turn; once per long rest or three Psionic dice.

3.name: Fancy Footwork
3.desc: A creature you attack in melee can't make opportunity attacks against you this turn.

3.name: Rakish Audacity
3.desc: Add CHA to initiative; Sneak Attack without advantage when alone in a duel within 5 ft and without disadvantage.

9.name: Panache
9.desc: Action, Persuasion vs Insight: a hostile target has disadvantage attacking anyone else and can't opportunity attack them for 1 min; a non-hostile one is charmed 1 min.

13.name: Elegant Maneuver
13.desc: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

17.name: Master Duelist
17.desc: Reroll a miss with advantage; once per short rest.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.desc: Cunning Action also covers Sleight of Hand, thieves' tools and Use an Object.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.desc: Climbing costs no extra movement; running jumps gain DEX mod feet.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.desc: Advantage on Stealth if you move at most half speed this turn.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.desc: Ignore class, race and level requirements of magic items.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.desc: Two turns in the first round (second at initiative - 10), unless surprised.
